entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: The police have officially withdrawn[n]the arrest warrant on the Phantom[n]Thieves...

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: As well as apologized for those who[n]led the investigation, citing they were[n]inadequate for the task.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Due to a drastic change in policy, it is[n]speculated that they had a change of[n]heart as well...

entries.speaker: Businessman
entries.en: So the police were in the wrong after all.[n]They're the ones who must've been[n]doing shady stuff.

entries.speaker: Young Businesswoman
entries.en: There's no way the Phantom Thieves[n]could be evil...

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: The actions of the Phantom Thieves show[n]no sign of stopping.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Change of heart police reports have[n]already surpassed one hundred cases.

entries.speaker: Surprised Male Student
entries.en: Only a hundred? I thought it would've[n]been double that already.

entries.speaker: Happy Male Student
entries.en: Yeah, I know whatcha mean. We see[n]news on them every day.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Meanwhile, there are reports that the[n]rate of crimes and suicides are declining—

entries.speaker: Female Pedestrian
entries.en: Will things be all right? Our child's going[n]to be born soon...

entries.speaker: Male Pedestrian
entries.en: It just means that more cases are being[n]exposed thanks to the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Male Pedestrian
entries.en: Don't worry. I'm sure they'll do something[n]about all that.
